name: Utrera (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of yellow, red, white, red and yellow with a broad white central stripe.
history: The flag of Utrera is formed of five horizontal bands, yellow, red, white, red and yellow; the municipal arms are usually placed at the centre of the white stripe. This flag was adopted in 1986 as the result of a competition called by the council, although documents detailing the purchase of the cloths for the old banner of the city show that it used these three colours.
